children: Cycurion renewed Chairman and CEO L. Kevin Kelly’s employment agreement, setting his annual base salary at $400,000 effective December 1, 2026.
Renewal and extension of employment agreement

No fixed term; $400,000 annual base salary and target annual performance bonus of 100% of base salary, not guaranteed. Severance is generally initially $1.2 million for qualifying termination, or $2.4 million following a qualifying change-in-control termination.
